Source code for test.classes.test_sub_cause_code

   1"""Test module for the sub_cause_code module, testing every ETSI ITS sub cause
   2code enumeration.
   3
   4For each enumeration this module verifies the member values (the ASN.1 identifier
   5followed by its ASN.1 integer value), the number of members, ``__slots__`` and the
   6custom JSON schema title and description. It also verifies, across every
   7enumeration, that each one defines UNAVAILABLE as its ``0`` value and that the
   8ASN.1 integer values of an enumeration are unique.
   9"""
  10

2549@pytest.mark.parametrize(
2550    argnames="enum_class",
2551    argvalues=SUB_CAUSE_CODE_ENUMS,
2552    ids=[enum_class.__name__ for enum_class in SUB_CAUSE_CODE_ENUMS],
2553)
2554def test_sub_cause_code_enums_asn_values_unique(enum_class: type[StrEnum]) -> None:
2555    """Test that every member value ends with an ASN.1 integer value and that
2556    these integer values are unique within the enumeration.
2557
2558    Args:
2559        enum_class (type[StrEnum]): The enumeration to test.
2560
2561    Returns:
2562        None
2563    """
2564    asn_values = []
2565    for member in enum_class:
2566        match = ASN_VALUE_PATTERN.match(member.value)
2567        assert match is not None
2568        asn_values.append(int(match.group(1)))
2569    assert len(set(asn_values)) == len(asn_values)
